deadline.value: Apply by January 10, 2027 for Fall enrollment.
deadline.quote: Application Deadline: January 10 for fall enrollment

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is not required for Physics PhD admission.
gre_general.quote: PHYSICS - PH.D. | Deadline for Fall Enrollment January 10 for fall enrollment | GRE General Requirement No

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE Subject Test is strongly recommended.
gre_subject.quote: PHYSICS - PH.D. | Additional Requirements Subject GRE test is strongly recommended

supervisor.value: A research advisor is selected at the end of the first year after passing the First Examination.
supervisor.quote: First year students receive full support from the Graduate Center. After passing the first exam at the end of year 1, students must select an advisor.

funding.value: First-year students receive full support from the Graduate Center, and entering doctoral students are considered for five-year institutional funding packages.
funding.quote: First year students receive full support from the Graduate Center. | Every applicant to the Graduate Center's doctoral programs will automatically be considered for five-year institutional funding packages.

entry_route.value: Applicants may enter with an undergraduate degree in physics or mathematics, or with a master's degree in physics.
entry_route.quote: Unless specifically noted on our deadlines and requirements chart, you do not need to have a master's degree before you start a Ph.D. program.

also.quote: In addition to the general University requirements for admission stated in this catalog, applicants must have received a minimum average of B in their work in undergraduate physics and mathematics and have taken a sufficient number of courses in these fields to indicate that they will profit from graduate study in physics. Applicants with master's degrees in physics from accredited institutions may be considered for admission, even if they do not satisfy the above requirements.
